# Contributing to Claude Code Best Practices

Thank you for considering contributing to our project! We welcome contributions from the community.

## How to Contribute

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a new branch for your feature or bug fix
3. Make your changes
4. Ensure your code follows our style guidelines
5. Add tests for any new functionality
6. Run the test suite to ensure nothing is broken
7. Submit a pull request

## Development Setup

Please refer to the README for setup instructions.

## Code Style

We follow [PEP 8](https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0008/) for Python code.
For other languages, we follow the community-accepted style guides.

We use [Prettier](https://prettier.io/) for formatting JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, and Markdown.
We use [Black](https://black.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) for Python code formatting.

## Pull Request Process

1. Ensure any install or build dependencies are removed before the end of the layer when doing a build.
2. Update the README.md with details of changes if applicable.
3. Increase the version numbers in any examples files and the README.md to the new version if applicable.
4. Your pull request will be reviewed by at least one maintainer.
5. Once approved, your pull request will be merged.

## Reporting Bugs

Please use the issue tracker to report bugs. Include:
- A clear and descriptive title
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Expected behavior
- Actual behavior
- Screenshots if applicable
- Environment details (OS, Python version, etc.)

## Feature Requests

Feature requests are welcome. Please use the issue tracker and label your request as "enhancement".
